purpose: See where things are and pick one.
layout: A full-bleed map (the `data-od-map` slot with its pins), a floating search or filter bar at the top, and a bottom sheet listing the nearby items (the first one peeking).

primaryAction.note: Inside the bottom sheet, on the selected item ("Directions", "Book").

avoid: A small map in a card
Drawing the map yourself (SVG, positioned divs or a photo) instead of the data-od-map slot

variants.layout: Full-bleed map, floating search on top, bottom sheet with nearby items. The map is the `data-od-map` slot, never drawn by hand.
Full-bleed map with a horizontal carousel of item cards floating near the bottom. The map is the `data-od-map` slot, never drawn by hand.
Map in the top half, a scrollable list of items in the bottom half with distance on each row. The map is the `data-od-map` slot, never drawn by hand.
